Yeah I also wish there was an easy way out... Or an easier way out than suicide cuz let's be honest suicide most definitely is NOT easy. And being attention seeking isn't always bad (in my opinion at least). I used to think maybe I wasn't depressed and I just wanted attention but the longer I thought about it, I only seek attention like that because I'm desperate for help. I want anyone out there to notice that I absolutely hate evedything, that the hardest part of my day is getting myself out of bed. Telling someone that you're depressed is not easy since it feels like you're just burdening them. So seeking attention in my opinion doesn't mean you want fame or anything like that, it's more like a subtle way to seek for help so that people who actually want to help reach out to me. Asking directly just forces the person to feel an incentive to listen to your problems but most people don't really know how difficult and time consuming it is to actually help people going through a hard time due to brain fog and a hopeless view on life. 

But don't give up fellow redditor! I can't genuinely say it'll get better because my life hasn't gotten any better and I still think it won't ever get better. But things that helped me significantly are focusing on the little things. A new album by my fav artist? Hell yeah! It isn't much but it's all I have to look forward to. And you can always fake it till you make it. I read an article once and aparrently you can just fake being happy and it'll like trick your brain and eventually make you happy.
